description: The largest 24h movers across the major-cap crypto universe, gainers or losers, from a refreshed market snapshot.

side.description: Which end of the board to return.

name: get_top_movers

available.description: False when this call has no data — a snapshot that is not warm yet, a domain switched off, or an argument that was rejected. NOT an error, and NOT a statement about the market.

crossAsset.description: Cross-asset ranking plus the universe/cohort sizes it was drawn from.

errors.description: Legs that failed. A partial answer says so here rather than reading as a quiet market.

fetchedAt.description: When the underlying snapshot was refreshed (epoch ms or ISO-8601). Age matters: these are cached reads, not live queries.

limit.description: Row cap applied to every list in this payload.

perChainUnavailable.description: True when the per-chain leg could not be read.

reason.description: Why the payload is absent, when `available` is false.

side.description: Which side was asked for — gainers or losers.

source.description: Price source behind the cross-asset ranking.

stale.description: True when the snapshot is past its refresh interval.

title: Top Gainers and Losers
